# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Gather accurate information about the incident.
3. Record detailed narratives.
4. Include relevant photographs or diagrams.
5. Interview witnesses where possible.
6. Record the exact date, time, and location of the incident.
7. Include a description of the tasks being performed.
8. Note any equipment, tools, or machinery involved.
9. Document the weather conditions, if relevant.
10. Record any applicable Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
11. Include information on immediate emergency response actions.
12. Document first aid or medical treatment provided.
13. Record details of any absent or unresponsive parties.
14. Record corrective actions taken or recommended.
15. Indicate the impact on the completion of tasks or projects.
16. Include legal or regulatory report forms, if required.
17. Document any further investigations to be made.
18. Include statements from the injured worker(s).
19. Submit the report to the designated safety official or supervisor.
20. Retain
